    <html lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Xatto$ — Record Studio</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Titan+One&amp;family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #060606;
    --bg-raised: #0E0E0E;
    --fg: #F4F1EC;
    --fg-dim: #9C9892;
    --line: #262626;

    --c-tidal:        #FFFFFF;
    --c-amazon:       #00D4C4;
    --c-deezer:       #A238FF;
    --c-ytmusic:      #FF0000;
    --c-tiktok:       #25F4EE;
    --c-tiktok-2:     #FE2C55;
    --c-telegram:     #26A5E4;
    --c-apple:        #FA233B;
    --c-spotify:      #1ED760;
    --c-instagram:    #C13584;
    --c-pandora:      #00A0DC;
    --c-snapchat:     #FFFC00;

    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
  }
  html { scroll-padding-top: 76px; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: inherit; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--fg);
    font-family: 'Poppins', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .display { font-family: 'Titan One', 'Poppins', sans-serif; }
  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
  .wrap { max-width: 1160px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 28px; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) { .wrap { padding: 0 20px; } }

  /* background texture: faint spray blobs */
  body {
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(circle at 10% 8%, rgba(162,17,203,0.10), transparent 34%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 14%, rgba(30,215,96,0.08), transparent 30%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 78% 78%, rgba(72,240,247,0.06), transparent 30%);
    background-attachment: fixed;
  }

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  header {
    position: sticky;
    top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    z-index: 50;
    background: rgba(6,6,6,0.88);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  nav.wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 68px; }
  .wordmark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Titan One', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
  .wordmark img { height: 30px; width: auto; }
  .nav-links { display: none; gap: 30px; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--fg-dim); }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--fg); }
  @media (min-width: 760px) { .nav-links { display: flex; } }
  .nav-cta {
    padding: 9px 18px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600;
    border: 2px solid var(--c-spotify); color: var(--c-spotify);
    border-radius: 8px;
  }
  .nav-cta:hover { background: var(--c-spotify); color: #060606; }

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero { padding: 72px 0 90px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .hero-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 48px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  @media (min-width: 880px) {
    .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1.15fr; gap: 30px; }
    .link-rail { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  }
  @media (min-width: 1180px) {
    .link-rail { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
  }
  .hero-art { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 22px; }
  .hero-art .logo-img { width: 100%; max-width: 480px; filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 40px rgba(162,17,203,0.25)); }
  .flag-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; }
  .flag-badge .fb-text { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--fg-dim); text-align: center; }
  .flag-badge .fb-text strong { display: block; color: var(--fg); font-size: 0.95rem; font-family: 'Titan One', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

  .link-rail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
  @media (min-width: 520px) and (max-width: 879px) { .link-rail { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
  .plink {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px;
    padding: 14px 18px;
    background: var(--bg-raised);
    border: 3px solid;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
  }
  .plink:hover { transform: translateX(4px); }
  .plink .icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .plink .icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }

  .plink.tidal     { border-color: var(--c-tidal);   color: var(--c-tidal); }
  .plink.amazon    { border-color: var(--c-amazon);  color: var(--c-amazon); }
  .plink.deezer    { border-color: var(--c-deezer);  color: var(--c-deezer); }
  .plink.ytmusic   { border-color: var(--c-ytmusic); color: #fff; }
  .plink.tiktok    { border-color: var(--c-tiktok);  color: #fff; }
  .plink.telegram  { border-color: var(--c-telegram);color: var(--c-telegram); }
  .plink.apple     { border-color: var(--c-apple);   color: var(--c-apple); }
  .plink.spotify   { border-color: var(--c-spotify); color: var(--c-spotify); }
  .plink.instagram { border-image: linear-gradient(135deg,#FFDC80,#F56040,#C13584,#5851DB) 1; color: #E1306C; }
  .plink.pandora   { border-color: var(--c-pandora); color: var(--c-pandora); }
  .plink.snapchat  { border-color: var(--c-snapchat);color: var(--c-snapchat); }

  /* ---------- SECTION SHARED ---------- */
  section { padding: 84px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .section-head { margin-bottom: 44px; }
  .section-head h2 { font-family: 'Titan One', sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.3rem); font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
  .section-head p { color: var(--fg-dim); max-width: 46ch; margin: 10px 0 0; }

  /* ---------- STORY ---------- */
  .story-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
  @media (min-width: 800px) { .story-grid { grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.2fr; align-items: center; } }
  .story-copy p { color: var(--fg-dim); margin: 0 0 16px; max-width: 56ch; }
  .story-copy p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .story-copy strong { color: var(--fg); font-weight: 600; }
  .story-mark { display: flex; justify-content: center; }
  .story-mark img { width: 100%; max-width: 340px; opacity: 0.95; }

  /* ---------- MERCH ---------- */
  .merch-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
  .merch-card { background: var(--bg-raised); border: 3px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; }
  .merch-card:nth-child(1) { border-color: var(--c-deezer); }
  .merch-card:nth-child(2) { border-color: var(--c-tiktok); }
  .merch-card:nth-child(3) { border-color: var(--c-telegram); }
  .merch-thumb { aspect-ratio: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #0A0A0A; }
  .merch-info { padding: 16px 18px 20px; }
  .merch-info .m-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.98rem; }
  .merch-info .m-price { color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 0.86rem; margin-top: 4px; }
  .merch-cta { text-align: center; margin-top: 40px; }
  .btn-shop {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 10px;
    font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem;
    border: 3px solid var(--c-spotify); color: var(--c-spotify);
  }
  .btn-shop:hover { background: var(--c-spotify); color: #060606; }

  /* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
  footer { padding: 40px 0; }
  .footer-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px; }
  .foot-links { display: flex; gap: 22px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--fg-dim); }
  .foot-links a:hover { color: var(--fg); }
  .copyright { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--fg-dim); margin-top: 24px; }
</style>
</head>
